eval: (() => { const g=window.__game; const acc={}; const add=(sc,tag)=>sc.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.isMesh&&!o.isPoints) return; let vis=true; let p=o; while(p){ if(!p.visible){vis=false;break;} p=p.parent;} if(!vis) return; const geo=o.geometry; const t=(geo.index?geo.index.count:geo.attributes.position.count)/3; const n=o.isInstancedMesh?o.count:1; let nm=o.name||(o.parent&&o.parent.name)||'?'; if(o.isInstancedMesh){ let q=o; while(q&&!/_chunks|_x/.test(q.name||'')) q=q.parent; nm=q?q.name.replace(/_x[0-9]+/,''):nm;} acc[tag+':'+nm]=(acc[tag+':'+nm]||0)+t*n; }); add(g.ext,'E'); add(g.int,'I'); return Object.entries(acc).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,25).map(e=>e[0]+' '+Math.round(e[1])); })()
